# Total CRD Size and Coverage

Here I plot the total size and coverage of all CRDs in the genome across each set of CRDs estimated.

```{r make_CRD_counts_data}
stat.vars <- 
    c(
        "CRD.length",
        "CRD.nPeaks",
        'peak.length-total'
    )
CRD.counts.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>%
    filter(CRD.feature %in% stat.vars) %>% 
    select(-c(CRD.feature.type)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from=CRD.feature, values_from=CRD.value) %>% 
    group_by(across(-all_of(c('CRDID', stat.vars)))) %>% 
    summarize(
        .groups='drop',
        nCRDs=dplyr::n(),
        CRD.length=sum(CRD.length),
        CRD.nPeaks=sum(CRD.nPeaks),
        `peak.length-total`=sum(`peak.length-total`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        CRD.density=1e6 * CRD.nPeaks / CRD.length,
        CRD.peak.coverage=100 * `peak.length-total` / CRD.length
    ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        all_of(c(stat.vars, 'nCRDs', 'CRD.density', 'CRD.peak.coverage')),
        names_to='CRD.feature',
        values_to='CRD.value'
    )
```

```{r plot_CRD_counts, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 12

nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
CRD.counts.df %>% 
    left_join(
        tribble(
            ~CRD.feature,        ~feature.name,
            "nCRDs",             '# of CRDs',               
            "CRD.nPeaks",        'Total CRD Size (# OCRs)',
            "CRD.length",        'Total CRD Size (bp)',
            "peak.length-total", 'Total OCR Size (bp)',
            "CRD.density",       '# OCRs per CRD Mb',
            "CRD.peak.coverage", '% CRDs Covered by OCRs',
        ) %>%
        mutate(feature.name=fct_reorder(feature.name, row_number())),
        by='CRD.feature'
    ) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_barplot,
                x.var='meanClusterSize',
                y.var='CRD.value',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.col='feature.name',
                y.scale.mode='m',
                y.axis.label.accuracy=1,
                scales='free_y', independent='y',
                # legend.position='top',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                # axis.text.y=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

# Compare Summary Stats over OCRs per peak pre/post merging 

Now we can plot summary statistics across OCRs per CRD. 
So for each CRD, compute statistics over OCR features (e.g. mean peak length (in bp)), then plot the distribution of this summary statistic across all CRDs for each feature.

## OCR Features

These features are related to OCR size and the size of the linked gene.

```{r make_OCR_summary_data}
OCR.summary.stats.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.feature.type %in% c('CRD.stats', 'peak.summary.stats')) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(
        CRD.feature,
        delim='-',
        names=c('feature', 'summary.stat'),
        # too_few='align_end'
        too_few='align_start'
    ) %>%
    mutate(summary.stat=ifelse(is.na(summary.stat), 'Size', summary.stat)) %>% 
    # mutate(feature=ifelse(is.na(feature), 'Size', feature)) %>% 
    filter(summary.stat != 'sd')
```

```{r plot_CRD_stats, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6
# #| eval: false

# Now plot correlation of SVs across datasets
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model',
        'feature'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
OCR.summary.stats.df %>% 
    mutate(CRD.value=ifelse(feature == 'CRD.density', 1e3 * CRD.value, CRD.value)) %>% 
    left_join(
        tribble(
            ~feature,              ~feature.name,             ~y.scale.mode, ~y.axis.label.accuracy,
            'gene.length',         'Assoc. Gene Length (bp)', 'mb',          1,
            'peak.length',         'Peak Length (bp)',        'mb',          1,
            'peak.distanceToTSS',  'Peak dist to TSS (bp)',   'mb',          1,
            'CRD.length',          'CRD Size (bp)',           'mb',          1,
            'CRD.nPeaks',          'CRD Size (# OCRs)',       'm',           1,
            'CRD.density',         'OCRs per CRD Kb',         'm',           0.01,
            'CRD.peak.coverage',   '% CRD Covered by OCRs',   'pct',         0.01,
        ) %>% 
        mutate(feature.name=fct_reorder(feature.name, row_number())),
        by='feature'
    ) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars, 'y.scale.mode', 'y.axis.label.accuracy'))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                x.var='meanClusterSize',
                y.var='CRD.value',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.row=c('feature.name', 'summary.stat'),
                scales='free_y',
                # axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=3,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

## OCR Types Frequencies per CRD

Each OCR is annotated as a specific type, so for each CRD we compute the relative abundance of each peak type e.g. promoter vs enhancer.  
Then for each category, we can plot the distribution of frequencies across all CRDs.

```{r make_CRD_annotation_frequencies}
CRD.annotation.frequencies.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.feature.type == 'peak.frequencies') %>% 
    separate_wider_delim(
        CRD.feature,
        delim='-',
        names=c('peak.annotation.type', 'peak.annotation', 'metric')
    ) %>% 
    filter(!(peak.annotation.type == 'merge.groups' & meanClusterSize != 'merged')) %>% 
    mutate(
        metric=
            case_when(
                metric == 'n'    ~ '# of Peaks in CRD',
                metric == 'freq' ~ '% of Peaks in CRD',
            )
    )
```

```{r plot_CRD_annotation_frequencies, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10

# Now plot correlation of SVs across datasets
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model',
        'peak.annotation.type'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
CRD.annotation.frequencies.df %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(nesting.vars)) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                y.var='peak.annotation',
                x.var='CRD.value',
                # y.scale.mode='pct',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.row='metric',
                facet.col='meanClusterSize',
                scales='free_x', independent='x',
                x.axis.label.accuracy=0.1,
                outlier.size=0.05,
                # legend.position='top',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=3,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

## OCR Differential statistics

For each OCR + each contrast we have the differential OCR statistics i.e. logFC + p.adjust.
Again we compute summary statistics for these metrics for each CRD separately, across all OCRs in the CRD. 
Then we plot the distribution of these summary statistics across all CRDs.

```{r make_CRD_differential_stats}
all.CRD.differential.stats.df <-
    all.CRD.features.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.feature.type == 'peak.differential.stats') %>% 
    separate_wider_delim(
        CRD.feature,
        delim='-',
        names=c('contrast', 'metric', 'summary.stat')
    ) %>%
    filter(summary.stat != 'sd')
```

```{r plot_CRD_differential_stats, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10

# Now plot correlation of SVs across datasets
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model',
        # 'AD.definition.column',
        'contrast'
    )
all.CRD.differential.stats.df %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                x.var='meanClusterSize',c('metric', 'summary.stat'),
                y.var='CRD.value',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.row=c('metric', 'summary.stat'),
                scales='free_y', independent='y',
                # scales='free_y', space='free_y', independent='y',
                legend.position='top',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=3,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

# Plot source frequencies of merged CRDs

For all merged CRDs show what types of CRDs were merged to create them.

```{r load_merged_CRDs}
all.merged.CRDs.df <- 
    list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='merged.CRDs') %>% 
    results_filter_fnc() %>% 
    filter(merging.level != 'separate') %>% 
    mutate(
        CRDs=
            future_pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=combine_CRD_Locations_and_PeakLists,
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    unnest(CRDs) %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, AD.definition.column,
        z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level,
        is.decorate.filtered,
        CRDID, detected.in.groups
    )
```

```{r plot_CRD_merge_origins, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10 

nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
all.merged.CRDs.df %>% 
    count(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, AD.definition.column,
        z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level,
        detected.in.groups, 
    ) %>%
    group_by(across(-all_of(c('detected.in.groups', 'n')))) %>% 
    mutate(freq=100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        c(n, freq),
        names_to='metric',
        values_to='value'
    ) %>%  
    mutate(
        metric=
            case_when(
                metric == 'n'    ~ '# of CRDs',
                metric == 'freq' ~ '% of CRDs',
            )
    ) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(nesting.vars)) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_barplot,
                y.var='detected.in.groups',
                x.var='value',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.col='metric',
                facet.row='sample.strategy',
                x.scale.mode='m',
                # scales='free', space='free',
                scales='free', independent='x',
                # scales='free_y', independent='y',
                # scales='free_y', independent=FALSE,
                # legend.position='top',
                x.axis.label.accuracy=1,
                # axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5, hjust=1),
                # axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )

# Define AD/Control-specific CRDs and plot features
